channel.title: Wildcard Watch: Danfoss
channel.description: Exploited vulnerabilities and attacks involving Danfoss, each with its fix status and first step.

item.title: Find old versions: Danfoss AK-SM 800A Series: 3 flaws exploited together
item.description:
Danfoss AK-SM 800A Series: Authentication bypass · low-privileged account · internet-facing · exploited · fix: 4.2

First step: This flaw dates from 2023, but CISA only now lists it as exploited. Find any system that still runs an affected version of Danfoss AK-SM 800A Series, and update or retire it.

Danfoss AK-SM 800A Series contains an improper input validation vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to run arbitrary commands on the affected system. CISA lists 2 more flaws in Danfoss AK-SM 800A Series as exploited on the same day (CVE-2023-25914, CVE-2025-41450).

Critical · Fix available · CVE-2023-25914, CVE-2023-25915, CVE-2025-41450

High · Fix available

item.title: Patch now: Danfoss (multiple products): Exploitation of Weak or Known Passwords in Danfoss AK-SC 355 and AK-SM 800 Series
item.description:
Danfoss (multiple products): exploited from day 0 · fix available

First step: Install the security update for the affected Danfoss products from the vendor advisory.

The Danfoss legacy AK-SC 355 and AK-SM 800 Series are vulnerable to unauthorized access when default credentials or known passwords are used for authentication.

Critical · Fix available · CVE-2026-127057
